verdict.stance: Constructive / Cleanest Nigerian Tier-1 Corporate Franchise (B/B3)
verdict.summary: Nigeria's premier corporate bank delivered NGN 675.83bn 9M26 PAT (~23% ROE) as impairment charges plunged 70.5% YoY to NGN 230.77bn and post-forbearance problem loans stabilized at a sector-low ~3.8% (vs ~8.1% UBA). NGN 5.07tn equity (~26% TCE/RWA) provides standout solvency, though ratings remain sovereign-capped at B/B3.

positives: Best-in-class Nigerian post-forbearance asset quality: ~3.8% NPL ratio (well below peers) with 9M26 impairments down 70.5% YoY to NGN 230.77bn.
Strong core banking profitability: 9M26 NII NGN 1.93tn, PBT NGN 928.79bn, PAT NGN 675.83bn (~23% ROE).
Fortress equity base (NGN 5.07tn, TCE/RWA ~26%) and clean external debt slate (zero public Eurobond overhang).
negatives: High ~56% foreign-currency gross loan book creates borrower FX-mismatch risk in oil/gas & corporate exposures.
Sovereign concentration (FGN bonds & CBN CRR reserves) caps Fitch IDR at 'B' and Moody's at 'B3'.
Normalization of FX revaluation / trading gains vs 2024-2025 windfall periods.

background.business_overview: Nigeria's top corporate & institutional bank by Tier-1 capital and profitability, with UK, Ghana, Sierra Leone, and Gambia subsidiaries.
